description:
Search workspace and get workspace info.

Actions (required params -> optional):
- info: workspace name, plan, and bot user
- search (-> query, filter.object="page"|"data_source", sort, limit): find pages/databases shared with integration

object.description: Filter by type: page or data_source (database)

full.description: Return the complete unbounded response (overrides max_chars and default item caps)

max_chars.description: Maximum characters in serialized response (1-100000, default 20000 or NOTION_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS); truncated responses include _truncation

name: workspace
